decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of permission P/2021/4719.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Daylight and Sunlight Report, Energy Statement Addendum, Design Statement of Changes, PL210 Rev. P02, PL211 Rev. P02, PL212 Rev. P02, PL213 Rev. P02, PL220 Rev. P02 - received 22nd April 2025, Cover letter � received 16th May 2025, 0701 Rev. P01, 0702 Rev. P01, 0703 Rev. P01, 0704 Rev. P01, Provisional Acoustic Design, Air Quality Assessment, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Bird Hazard Management Plan, Fire Strategy, L002 Rev. A, L010, Landscape Management and Maintenance Plan, Phase 2 Site Investigation Report, Transport Statement � received 13th June 2025, SLP002 Rev. P02, PL002 Rev. P03,  PL200 Rev. P05, PL201 Rev. P05, PL202 Rev. P04, PL203 Rev. P04, PL204 Rev. P04 � received 3rd September 2025) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission
Condition : 3 - No development shall take place above ground level until samples of all materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. 
- brick (including brick, feature brick panel, brick framing feature); 
- Tiles/Roof covering; 
- window treatment (including sections/reveals, quoin detail, screens); 
- all privacy measures; and 
- any other materials/details to be used. 
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter. 
Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and protect living conditions, to satisfy the requirements of policies CC1 and CC2 of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 4 - No development shall take place above ground level until the developer has entered into a binding contract to provide the following works on land to the south of the site adjacent to 50-64 Oxford Court, Oxford Way consisting of: 
�	Providing play equipment and informal recreation space;
�	Enhancements to soft landscaping; 
�	Overhauling and improving recycling facilities and; 
�	Providing bike storage. 
These shall be implemented in their entirety, before any part of the building is occupied. 
Reason: To enhance the public realm and ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the adjacent area, without which the present proposal would be unacceptable in view of the loss of existing site servicing provisions in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2 and SC5
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, elevations of the proposed secure cycle storage arrangements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall comprise 'Sheffield' stands and shall conform to the West London Cycle Parking Guidance. The cycle store and the guest cycle parking shall be made available to occupants on first occupation of the approved development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.
Reason: To ensure that secure cycle spaces are provided and retained for the occupiers of the residential units, in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2 and London Plan Policy T2.
Condition : 6 - The development, hereby approved, shall take place in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan approved 21st November 2024 under application P/2024/2935.
Reason: To ensure that the construction takes place in an acceptable manner and would not cause harm to neighbouring buildings or the wider area.
Condition : 7 - A. The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Statement received 10/12/2021 and the Energy Statement Addendum received 22nd April 2025.
B. Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
C. Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.
D. If the development as implemented fails to result in a net zero-carbon development, as indicated by the first set of data recovered under clause 'C' above, the applicant shall, within six months of first occupation have entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure a suitable contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund to compensate fully for this shortfall at the rate applicable at the time of first occupation.
Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ1.
Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litr es per person per day or less.
Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI5 and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ2.
Condition : 9 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
- At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
- At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
- No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with the London Plan Policy SI2 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.
Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access to Oxford Way shall be permanently closed and the kerbs, verge, and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: To enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway; in accordance with Local Plan policies EC1 & EC2.
Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority. The drainage hierarchy shall make use of green infrastructure technology to comply with the hierarchy set out in London Plan Policy SI3 and the runoff rate must not exceed 2.5litres/second. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.
Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site, in accordance with relevant policy requirements including but not limited to London Plan policies SI12 and SI13 (and its associated Sustainable Design and Construction SPG), the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems and Local Plan policy EQ3
Condition : 12 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme approved under the preceding condition has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.
Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed, in accordance with the Non-Statutory Technical Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems, the National Planning Policy Framework (Paragraph 103), London Plan policies SI12 and SI13 (together with associated guidance to these policies) and Local Plan policy EQ3.
Condition : 13 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a. Part A of condition 13 has been approved under application P/2024/2923 dated 27th November 2024. The development must be undertaken in accordance with the previously approved details and the Phase II Supplementary Site Investigation..
b. If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval. The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied. During the course of the development:
c. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. Before the development is first brought into use:
d. The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use. The Local Planning Authority (LPA) therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety in accordance with policy EQ8 Contamination of the adopted Local Plan.
Supporting notes:
a. An initial phase 1 desk study must be submitted with the original application and will include the aims and objectives, data collection, site reconnaissance (walk over survey), and development of the initial Conceptual Model (CM), which identifies all potential pollutant linkages on the site. The report should also make recommendations for the further gathering of information and 
Condition : 14 - The development hereby permitted shall obtain a 'Secured by Design' certificate
Reason: In order to promote a safer environment
Condition : 15 - Before first occupation of the hereby approved development the waste and recycling stores shall be made available for use in accordance with the approved plans and shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the duration of the development.
Reason: To ensure the storage areas are suitable for use and in accordance with policy EQ7
Condition : 16 - The development, hereby approved, shall be carried out in accordance with the Air Quality Assessment.
Reason: In the interests of Air Quality and to satisfy the requirements of policy EQ4 of the adopted Local Plan
Condition : 17 - A.	The development shall include a scheme for the insulation of the proposed dwellings against the transmission of externally generated noise, taking account of any ventilation requirements necessary, such that the maximum noise levels permitted within the dwellings do not exceed those that are specified in Table 4 of British Standard 8233:2014 [Living Rooms = 35 dB LAeq, 16 hours; Dining room/area = 40 dB LAeq, 16 hours; Bedroom = 35 dB LAeq, 16 hours during day-time (07:00 - 23:00) and Bedroom = 30 dB LAeq, 8 hours during night-time (23:00 - 07:00)] and night-time (23:00 - 07:00) LAmax noise levels within bedrooms do not exceed 45 dB LAmax more than 10 to 15 times per night.

B.	The development shall not be occupied until sound insulation test reports carried by a suitably qualified professional for the purposes of such tests demonstrating compliance with the scheme described under Part (a) of this condition, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Noise tests shall be carried out taking account of worst-case environmental conditions, such as easterly operations at Heathrow, peak time traffic flows wind speed, direction and presence of temperature inversion. Continuous logged data shall be submitted.
Reason: In order to ensure that the future occupants of the units do not suffer an unreasonable level of noise and disturbance and to accord with Local Plan Policy EQ5.
